list.name: bot_filter
list.label: Account Filter
list.query: All Accounts : 1 = 1, Exclude High-Freq Bots (<= 15 posts/hr) : post_count <= 15, Exclude Bots (<= 5 posts/hr) : post_count <= 5, Bots Only (> 15 posts/hr) : post_count > 15

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(passed_sieve) / nullIf(sum(raw_received), 0), 1) FROM bluesky.funnel_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
SELECT round(avg(raw_rate), 1) FROM bluesky.funnel_stats WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 MINUTE
SELECT count(*) FROM bluesky.enriched_posts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND is_breaking_claim >= 0.85

panels.title: Live Stream Rate: Raw Firehose vs Passed to AI (msgs/sec)

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 10 SECOND) AS time, round(avg(raw_rate), 1) AS "Raw Firehose (Total msgs/s)", round(avg(passed_rate), 1) AS "Passed Sieve to AI (msgs/s)" FROM bluesky.funnel_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Pipeline Sieve Funnel: Stage-by-Stage Retention & Drop-Off

targets.rawSql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT '1. Raw Firehose Ingested' AS Stage, sum(raw_received) AS Volume, '100.0%' AS "Relative Share", 'Total raw events streamed from Bluesky WebSocket' AS "Pipeline Meaning" FROM bluesky.funnel_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT '2. Filtered: Replies & Threads', sum(dropped_replies), concat('-', toString(round(100.0 * sum(dropped_replies) / nullIf(sum(raw_received), 0), 1)), '%'), 'Dropped by Sieve (child replies / non-root threads)' FROM bluesky.funnel_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT '3. Filtered: Non-English', sum(dropped_non_en), concat('-', toString(round(100.0 * sum(dropped_non_en) / nullIf(sum(raw_received), 0), 1)), '%'), 'Dropped by Sieve (metadata language != en)' FROM bluesky.funnel_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT '4. Filtered: Obscene / Spam / NSFW', sum(dropped_spam_nsfw), concat('-', toString(round(100.0 * sum(dropped_spam_nsfw) / nullIf(sum(raw_received), 0), 1)), '%'), 'Dropped by Sieve (script mismatch, adult labels, spam domains)' FROM bluesky.funnel_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT '5. Passed Sieve to AI', sum(passed_sieve), concat(toString(round(100.0 * sum(passed_sieve) / nullIf(sum(raw_received), 0), 1)), '%'), 'Forwarded to Laya System One AI (100% - Replies - NonEn - Spam)' FROM bluesky.funnel_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT '6. Enriched in ClickHouse', count(*), '100% of Passed', 'Classified and indexed with sentiment, virality, geo, safety' FROM bluesky.enriched_posts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) UNION ALL SELECT '7. Breaking Claims Alert', countIf(is_breaking_claim >= 0.85), concat(toString(round(100.0 * countIf(is_breaking_claim >= 0.85) / nullIf(count(*), 0), 2)), '%'), 'Escalated breaking news claims (conf >= 0.85)' FROM bluesky.enriched_posts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)) ORDER BY Stage ASC

SELECT arrayJoin(hashtags) AS hashtag, count(*) AS "Post Count" FROM bluesky.enriched_posts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND hashtag != '' AND is_nsfw < 0.5 GROUP BY hashtag ORDER BY "Post Count" DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Sentiment Breakdown per Top 10 Hashtags (100% Stacked)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  hashtag,
  countIf(sentiment = 'positive') AS Positive,
  countIf(sentiment = 'neutral') AS Neutral,
  countIf(sentiment = 'negative') AS Negative
FROM (
  SELECT arrayJoin(hashtags) AS hashtag, sentiment
  FROM bluesky.enriched_posts
  WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND hashtag != '' AND is_nsfw < 0.5
    AND hashtag IN (
      SELECT arrayJoin(hashtags) AS h
      FROM bluesky.enriched_posts
      WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND h != '' AND is_nsfw < 0.5
      GROUP BY h
      ORDER BY count(*) DESC
      LIMIT 10
    )
)
GROUP BY hashtag
ORDER BY (Positive + Neutral + Negative) DESC

SELECT arrayJoin(hashtags) AS hashtag, round(avg(virality), 2) AS avg_virality, count(*) AS sample_posts FROM bluesky.enriched_posts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND hashtag != '' GROUP BY hashtag HAVING sample_posts >= 2 ORDER BY avg_virality DESC, sample_posts DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Most Active Posters (Controlled by Account Filter Toggle)

targets.rawSql: SELECT author_did, count(*) AS post_count, round(avg(virality), 2) AS avg_virality, topK(1)(category)[1] AS dominant_category FROM bluesky.enriched_posts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY author_did HAVING ${bot_filter} ORDER BY post_count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT geo_region AS region, count(*) AS "Mention Count" FROM bluesky.enriched_posts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND geo_region != 'global_none' GROUP BY region ORDER BY "Mention Count" DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT category, count(*) AS count FROM bluesky.enriched_posts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND category != 'unknown' GROUP BY category ORDER BY count DESC

panels.title: Posts by Category (Live Curves by Category)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(created_at, INTERVAL 15 SECOND) AS time,
  countIf(category = 'tech') AS Tech,
  countIf(category = 'entertainment') AS Entertainment,
  countIf(category = 'politics') AS Politics,
  countIf(category = 'finance') AS Finance,
  countIf(category = 'lifestyle') AS Lifestyle,
  countIf(category = 'other') AS Other
FROM bluesky.enriched_posts
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT toString(created_at) AS timestamp, category, geo_region, round(is_breaking_claim, 2) AS breaking_conf, round(virality, 2) AS virality, text FROM bluesky.enriched_posts WHERE is_breaking_claim >= 0.85 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 25
